registration_timing: Registered after the original 125-triplet threshold-surface results and figures were inspected, and specifically after observing that the one-at-a-time noisy/distorting-boundary transition-share profile was flat, but before computing or inspecting the class-transition decomposition requested here.
reason: The original binary indicator records only whether baseline and replicate classes differ. It can therefore remain unchanged when the noisy_upper boundary reallocates observations between noisy and distorting. A flat binary transition profile must not be interpreted as invariance of severity labels.

frozen_scope.threshold_grid: Use exactly the parent plan's 5 x 5 x 5 full-factorial grid; no values may be added, removed, or selected.
frozen_scope.required_decomposition: For every Model x Lane x Statistic x threshold triplet, emit all 16 BaselineClass x ReplicateClass cells, including structural zeros.
frozen_scope.required_one_at_a_time_profile: At canonical overfit_upper and acceptable_upper, report replicate noisy and distorting counts/shares at each of the five frozen noisy_upper values, with baseline class counts reported separately.
required_checks: Every transition matrix sums to its Person-replicate denominator.
Off-diagonal cell counts sum exactly to the parent binary ClassTransitions count.
Canonical transition matrices reproduce the stored canonical transition matrix.
Results are invariant to input row order.
frozen_scope.required_visual: Show one-at-a-time noisy_upper replicate noisy/distorting shares by Statistic, with the canonical 2.00 reference and without combining classes into an ordinal score.
